description: The two real example apps (tdk-saas-starter and tdk-restaurant-example) on a clean machine with the published CLI (moved from examples-e2e.yml, #1299): install TDK from npm, set up and doctor the project, install the frontend dependencies for the host typecheck, then tdk up and require the apps' real routes: JSON from every business endpoint and an HTML page from each frontend. The workflow runs one matrix leg per app; API_CHECKS and WEB_CHECKS select the routes.
